steps.text: Hey it's Ethan
Oh perfect
I wanted to talk to you about {{name:hailey}}
Really, about what ?
She actually likes you a lot
I kind of figured that😂
Yeah seems pretty obvious
But..
I kind of like her too
I thought so
Does it bother you?
Not at all
I just want her to do well in her exams
Of course, that's the priority for me too
I just wanted to be honest with you about how I feel
I appreciate that
And I want you to know that I support you two spending time together outside of studying if you both want that
She’d love that
I’d like that too
As long as the studying stays the priority
We can’t let things get in the way of her exams
Exactly
It was nice talking to you about it
Same here
I want to be informed about everything, so please don't hesitate to keep me updated
Of course, I will keep you updated on everything
And make sure to encourage her to spend time with me outside of studying too
If she gets smart, it's the least I can do 😂
